description: This file defines the TrustedCertificateAuthority class, which models a trusted CA configuration within the Hono device registry management API. It handles certificate parsing, validation, and exhibits properties related to X.509 certificates, public keys, and validity periods.

classes.name: TrustedCertificateAuthority
classes.description: Represents a trusted CA configuration, encapsulating certificate details, validation logic, and key information as specified in the Hono API schema.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the object contains all necessary data for a valid trusted CA, including certificate presence or proper public key verification.

methods.name: setSubjectDn
methods.description: Sets the distinguished name of the CA's subject using a string or X500Principal.

methods.name: getSubjectDn
methods.description: Retrieves the subject distinguished name as an X500Principal, preferring the embedded certificate subject if available.

methods.name: getSubjectDnAsString
methods.description: Returns the subject distinguished name formatted as an RFC 2253 string.

methods.name: setPublicKey
methods.description: Sets the DER-encoded public key for the CA.

methods.name: getPublicKey
methods.description: Retrieves the DER-encoded public key, either from the certificate or internal storage.

methods.name: setCertificate
methods.description: Sets the certificate from a DER-encoded byte array, parsing it into an X509Certificate.

methods.name: setKeyAlgorithm
methods.description: Specifies the algorithm used for the public key (e.g., RSA).

methods.name: getKeyAlgorithm
methods.description: Retrieves the algorithm used by the public key, from the certificate or set property.

methods.name: setNotBefore
methods.description: Sets the earliest allowed usage time for the CA.

methods.name: getNotBefore
methods.description: Gets the earliest usage time, from the certificate or internal property.

methods.name: setNotAfter
methods.description: Sets the latest allowed usage time for the CA.

methods.name: getNotAfter
methods.description: Gets the latest usage time, from the certificate or internal property.
